answer: The protocol validates 1,000 unique location proofs by measuring signal transit across a rugged mesa grid. An issuer assigns geographic coordinates as a copper anchor, and each receipt proves occupancy. A verifier listens for a silent whisper of latency to detect relay fraud, triggering a penalty upon any drift. Honest nodes pay linear travel costs, while 1,000 fakes incur unsustainable signal congestion without relay help.
